_note: Windward epochs/eras DRAFT (2026-11-05, mission control with Felix). Single source for the epoch timeline and, later, the coast lab and game. Dates marked approx are approximate; 'verify' items were not source-checked yet. 2026-11-05 rev 2: Herring and Light split into New Crown / The Silver Sea / Light and Stone (Felix).

eras.name: Norse coast
eras.summary: Bohuslän is part of Norway. Longships, chieftains, rock carvings already ancient.

eras.name: Fortress and fish
eras.summary: Towns and fortresses rise on a Norwegian coast; fishing villages are first recorded.

eras.name: Border wars
eras.summary: A herring period, then war between Sweden and Denmark-Norway over the coast.

eras.name: New border
eras.summary: Bohuslän becomes Swedish. Carlsten fortress rises over Marstrand.
events: Treaty of Roskilde: Bohuslän becomes Swedish

eras.name: Crown shores
eras.summary: A new law lets subjects build fishing huts on crown land. Göteborg trades with China.
events: Ordinance: build huts on crown land
Götheborg sinks at the harbour mouth

eras.name: The silver comes
eras.summary: The herring returns. Salteries and the first train-oil works.
events: ~ Oil boiling on a factory scale

eras.name: Honour and Life
eras.summary: Marstrand is a free port: smugglers, refugees, foreign ships. Oil lights European streets.

eras.name: Last silver
eras.summary: Works shed workers, wars rage in Europe, and the herring thins out.

eras.name: Empty harbours
eras.summary: Ruined works and a desolate coast. Lasse-Maja sits in Carlsten.

eras.name: Lights go up
eras.summary: The great lighthouses are lit one by one. Steamers appear.

eras.name: The second silver
eras.summary: Herring under the lights. Canneries, fish guano, granite quarries.

eras.name: Motor and canning
eras.summary: Engines arrive in fishing boats; canneries and emigration.

eras.name: Spirits at sea
eras.summary: Prohibition in Norway and rationing in Sweden: liquor smuggling along the coast.

eras.name: Mines and neutrality
eras.summary: War in Europe. Mines in the Skagerrak, a neutral coast, boats from occupied Norway.

eras.name: Summer guests
eras.summary: Holiday homes, leisure boats, bridges to the islands, and the friendly west-coast–east-coast feud begins: rich Stockholmers buying up fishermen's cottages.

eras.name: Leisure sailing
eras.summary: Marinas and boatbuilding; the coast becomes a sailing playground.

eras.name: Summer coast
eras.summary: The lure: just sail, no save, the meeting place between times.

seasonArc: Felix 2026-11-05: seasons run as one year across the timeline — autumn to winter (Kings and raiders), spring (New Crown) to summer and autumn (Silver Sea), late autumn and winter (Light and Stone), a long cold spring (Engines and wars), then summer (Summer guests, Today). Season = mood of the era; the historical herring fishery was a winter fishery (see GAME-DESIGN.md).
flow: Felix 2026-11-05: start casual on Today's coast → time warp to ~1905 (end of IV) → first jump to the end of New border (~1700), so soon after warming up the 1706 crown-land ordinance lets you claim and build. Eras unlock spaced out across the timeline, not in order, so moving back and forth stays engaging.
